paraphrase: For correction of a teacher's home-school assignment, the official FAQ describes moving the Dapodik assignment from the old to the new home school and deactivating the previous assignment to prevent duplicate records. It supports interpreting induk as the administrative home assignment. The original statistical books separately tabulate induk and noninduk teacher attachments and use induk only in subsequent teacher tables.
limits: Administrative headcounts are not FTE. The FAQ does not demonstrate a person-level reconciliation of the two archived books. Follow each book's published category rather than adding noninduk attachments.
